lede: The Fourth of July weekend dominates this week, with Better Than Ezra, the Red White and Blues celebration, a drone show, and a full run of events stretching across both Telluride and Mountain Village. Once the holiday settles down, the Board of County Commissioners has multiple meetings scheduled for July 8 — including a special session out in Norwood at the Sheriff Annex — and both the Open Space and Ecology Commissions convene, though none of those agendas have been posted yet.
